key: I hear there are two rival gangs that fight for control of this ward.
en: I hear there are two rival gangs that fight for control of this ward.
ja: この区の支配をめぐって 二つの組が争っているらしい

key: I'll take 'em both on.
en: I'll take 'em both on.
ja: オレは 両方とも 相手にしてやる

key: This is normally such a quiet and peaceful ward, but lately...
en: This is normally such a quiet and peaceful ward, but lately...
ja: いつもは静かで平和な区なのに 最近は……

key: Life here was stressful for a while, but now everyone's working hard to make it better.
en: Life here was stressful for a while, but now everyone's working hard to make it better.
ja: しばらくは つらい暮らしだったけど 今はみんな よくしようと がんばってる

key: Okay! I've gotta do my part too.
en: Okay! I've gotta do my part too.
ja: よし! わたしも 自分の役目を果たさなきゃ

key: Maybe some of the workers would like freshly-baked Lava Cookies. Or should I make Old Gateau?
en: Maybe some of the workers would like freshly-baked Lava Cookies. Or should I make Old Gateau?
ja: 焼きたてのフエンせんべいを 作業の人たちに配ろうかな。それとも もりのヨウカンにする?

key: Suicide and terrorism? What rubbish.
en: Suicide and terrorism? What rubbish.
ja: 自殺にテロ? くだらん

key: The Lapis Ward is above such ostentatious things.
en: The Lapis Ward is above such ostentatious things.
ja: ラピス区は そんな派手ごとより 上等なのだ

key: Let me tell you about life's two greatest virtues:
en: Let me tell you about life's two greatest virtues:
ja: 人生の 二大美徳を 教えてやろう

key: Charity,
en: Charity,
ja: 慈善と

key: And gambling.
en: And gambling.
ja: そして かけごとだ

key: And at a certain hour in the morning, there is no longer a difference!
en: And at a certain hour in the morning, there is no longer a difference!
ja: そして 朝のある時刻には その二つに 違いなど なくなる!

key: Trainer, have you heard the legend of the Savage?
en: Trainer, have you heard the legend of the Savage?
ja: トレーナーよ 「サベージ」の伝説を 聞いたことはあるか?

key: Would you like to?
en: Would you like to?
ja: 聞いてみるかね?

key: This story is about one of Reborn's most infamous Gym Leaders.
en: This story is about one of Reborn's most infamous Gym Leaders.
ja: これは リボーンで最も悪名高いジムリーダーの一人の話だ

key: Shade.
en: Shade.
ja: シェイド

key: There once was a challenger of the League whose real name has since been forgotten.
en: There once was a challenger of the League whose real name has since been forgotten.
ja: かつて 本名すら忘れられた リーグの挑戦者がいた

key: This person was a fierce battler, without a doubt.
en: This person was a fierce battler, without a doubt.
ja: その者は まぎれもなく すさまじい戦い手だった

key: He had already acquired several Badges when he made his first challenge to Shade.
en: He had already acquired several Badges when he made his first challenge to Shade.
ja: すでにいくつかのバッジを手にして 彼はシェイドに初めて挑んだ

key: He lost.
en: He lost.
ja: 彼は 負けた

key: This is not uncommon, as any Reborn Gym Leader is sure to put up a fight.
en: This is not uncommon, as any Reborn Gym Leader is sure to put up a fight.
ja: リボーンのジムリーダーは 誰もが手ごわい。珍しいことではない

key: So, they had a rematch.
en: So, they had a rematch.
ja: そこで 再戦となった

key: He lost again.
en: He lost again.
ja: 彼は また負けた

key: And again.
en: And again.
ja: そして また

key: Although the reason should not be presumed, the more he fought and lost to Shade, the more hysterical he seemed to become.
en: Although the reason should not be presumed, the more he fought and lost to Shade, the more hysterical he seemed to become.
ja: 理由を決めつけるべきではないが 戦って負けるほど 彼は正気を失っていくように見えた

key: He would stumble out of the Gym, gasping for air between bouts of unceasing laughter.
en: He would stumble out of the Gym, gasping for air between bouts of unceasing laughter.
ja: ジムからよろめき出ては 止まらぬ笑いの合間に 息を切らしていた

key: As his failure continued, so did his madness.
en: As his failure continued, so did his madness.
ja: 敗北が続くほど 狂気もまた深まった

key: It was during this time that the locals began calling the frantic soul "Savage".
en: It was during this time that the locals began calling the frantic soul "Savage".
ja: そのころから 地元の者たちは その狂った魂を「サベージ」と呼び始めた

key: Laughter soon turned to silence.
en: Laughter soon turned to silence.
ja: 笑いは やがて 沈黙に変わった

key: Silence turned to a creeping smirk.
en: Silence turned to a creeping smirk.
ja: 沈黙は じわりと広がる薄笑いに変わった

key: That smirk turned into a pale grin, seething with violence.
en: That smirk turned into a pale grin, seething with violence.
ja: その薄笑いは 暴力をたぎらせた 青白い笑みへと変わった

key: And he never spoke after that,
en: And he never spoke after that,
ja: そして 彼は それきり口をきかなくなった

key: Except sparingly, in the form of cryptic riddles.
en: Except sparingly, in the form of cryptic riddles.
ja: まれに 謎めいたなぞかけを口にするだけで

key: Just like Shade himself.
en: Just like Shade himself.
ja: まるで シェイドその人のように

key: Whatever the reason behind this story is, we might never know...
en: Whatever the reason behind this story is, we might never know...
ja: この話の裏に何があるのか 我々には永遠にわからぬだろう……

key: But I assure you, every word of it is true.
en: But I assure you, every word of it is true.
ja: だが 一言一句 真実だと 保証しよう

key: As for the Savage...
en: As for the Savage...
ja: サベージは その後……

key: He did eventually beat Shade.
en: He did eventually beat Shade.
ja: ついに シェイドを 打ち破った

key: But even his victory did not restore his twisted personality to as it was before.
en: But even his victory did not restore his twisted personality to as it was before.
ja: だが 勝利をもってしても ゆがんだ人格は 元には戻らなかった

key: I am not sure whatever became of him.
en: I am not sure whatever became of him.
ja: その後 どうなったのかは わからん

key: It's possible he's still facing down the League even now.
en: It's possible he's still facing down the League even now.
ja: 今もなお リーグに挑み続けているのかもしれん

key: But whatever the case, he is, and likely always will be, more Shade than man.
en: But whatever the case, he is, and likely always will be, more Shade than man.
ja: いずれにせよ 彼は人というより シェイドそのもの。おそらく 永遠に

key: Fair choice.
en: Fair choice.
ja: 賢明な選択だ

key: It is not for the faint of heart.
en: It is not for the faint of heart.
ja: 気の弱い者向けの話では ないからな

key: How are you doing, Trainer?
en: How are you doing, Trainer?
ja: 調子はどうだい トレーナー?

key: Are things too easy for you? Or too hard?
en: Are things too easy for you? Or too hard?
ja: 簡単すぎるかい? それとも 難しすぎる?

key: Let me tell you what you can do.
en: Let me tell you what you can do.
ja: いい方法を 教えてあげよう

key: You might find it's a little too late, but next time you're ever looking to swing things in another direction...
en: You might find it's a little too late, but next time you're ever looking to swing things in another direction...
ja: もう手遅れかもしれないが 次にバランスを変えたくなったときは……

key: If someone asks you for a password, tell them "leveloffset".
en: If someone asks you for a password, tell them "leveloffset".
ja: 誰かに合言葉を聞かれたら 「leveloffset」と答えるといい

key: You could make it so everyone is a little weaker than they normally are,
en: You could make it so everyone is a little weaker than they normally are,
ja: みんなを ふだんより少し弱くもできるし

key: Or maybe just a little stronger.
en: Or maybe just a little stronger.
ja: 少し 強くもできる

key: That one works at a flat rate.
en: That one works at a flat rate.
ja: そっちは 一定の値で効く

key: If you'd rather it scale based on a certain percentage, try saying "percentlevel".
en: If you'd rather it scale based on a certain percentage, try saying "percentlevel".
ja: 割合で変えたいなら 「percentlevel」と 言ってみるといい

key: Be careful with these, will you?
en: Be careful with these, will you?
ja: 使うときは 気をつけてくれよ?

key: There's no built in limits beyond the maximum level,
en: There's no built in limits beyond the maximum level,
ja: 最大レベル以外に 制限は入っていないからね

key: And we wouldn't want things to get unreasonable.
en: And we wouldn't want things to get unreasonable.
ja: めちゃくちゃになっては 困るだろう

key: You're the master of your destiny; never forget that.
en: You're the master of your destiny; never forget that.
ja: 自分の運命の主は 自分だ。それを 忘れないで

key: Just right?
en: Just right?
ja: ちょうどいい?

key: Well, aren't you a regular plum?
en: Well, aren't you a regular plum?
ja: へえ 大したもんじゃないか

key: Keep it up, hot stuff.
en: Keep it up, hot stuff.
ja: その調子で いこうぜ イケてるね

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
